cc:Work.dc:title: 3-DoF planar inverse kinematics
cc:Work.dc:description: Theta2 is the signed rotation from the forward extension of L1 to L2 (clockwise and negative in this pose). The triangle interior angle is beta = pi - abs(theta2), not theta2. Subtract L3 along phi from the target to obtain the wrist.
